reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Nevada
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: Can a landlord evict a tenant for violating statutory tenant obligations?

    This program encodes the relevant parts of:
      - NV Rev Stat  40.251 (2021)
      - NV Rev Stat  40.2512 (2021)
      - NV Rev Stat  40.2514 (2021)

    And encodes a factual scenario consistent with the question:
      - Tenant violated statutory tenant obligations (modeled as failure to perform tenant's basic/contractual
        obligations under NRS Chapter 118A)
      - Proper 5-day notice served and expired
      - Tenant remains in possession without landlord consent
*/

/* =========================
   Basic domain facts
   ========================= */

state(nevada).
focus_year(2021).

/* Parties */
landlord(l1).
tenant(t1).

/* Premises / tenancy characterization */
dwelling_unit_subject_to_118a(t1).  % dwelling unit subject to NRS chapter 118A

/* Scenario facts: "violating statutory tenant obligations" */
failed_basic_or_contractual_obligations_under_118a(t1).

/* Possession and consent */
tenant_continues_in_possession(t1).
landlord_consents_to_possession(l1, t1) :- fail.  % explicitly no consent (closed-world style)

/* Notice facts */
notice_served_days(l1, t1, obligations_118a, 5).
notice_expired(l1, t1, obligations_118a).

/* Optional facts used by statute exceptions; not present in this scenario */
tenant_is_60_or_older(_T) :- fail.
tenant_has_disability(_T) :- fail.
tenant_is_shutdown_worker_or_household(_T) :- fail.
nrs_118a315_exception_applies(_T) :- fail.  % referenced by statutes as an exception gate

/* =========================
   Scenario statement (facts summary)
   ========================= */

scenario_statement :-
    state(nevada),
    focus_year(2021),
    landlord(l1),
    tenant(t1),
    dwelling_unit_subject_to_118a(t1),
    failed_basic_or_contractual_obligations_under_118a(t1),
    notice_served_days(l1, t1, obligations_118a, Days),
    Days >= 5,
    notice_expired(l1, t1, obligations_118a),
    tenant_continues_in_possession(t1),
    \+ landlord_consents_to_possession(l1, t1).

/* =========================
   Statute translations
   ========================= */

/* ---- NV Rev Stat  40.251 (2021) ----
   Unlawful detainer for certain holdovers, including:
   40.251(1)(b)(2): dwelling unit subject to 118A; 5+ day notice where tenant failed to perform
                   basic/contractual obligations under chapter 118A; tenant remains without consent
                   after expiration of notice.
*/

% 40.251(1)(b)(2): required notice days for 118A obligation breach holdover
statute_40_251_notice_days_required(obligations_118a, 5).

% 40.251(1)(a) general periodic tenancies (encoded for completeness)
statute_40_251_notice_days_required(week_to_week, 7).
statute_40_251_notice_days_required(periodic_other_than_week_to_week, 30).
statute_40_251_notice_days_required(tenancy_at_will, 5).

% 40.251(2): extension for 60+ or disability for periodic tenancy under (a) or (b),
% except landlord need not allow extension if shorter notice under 40.251(1)(b)(2) applies.
statute_40_251_extension_requestable(Tenant) :-
    ( tenant_is_60_or_older(Tenant)
    ; tenant_has_disability(Tenant)
    ),
    % Extension applies only to periodic tenancy notices, not to the 5-day obligations notice:
    \+ statute_40_251_shorter_notice_obligations_path_applies(Tenant).

statute_40_251_shorter_notice_obligations_path_applies(Tenant) :-
    dwelling_unit_subject_to_118a(Tenant),
    failed_basic_or_contractual_obligations_under_118a(Tenant).

% 40.251(3)-(4): shutdown-related extension (encoded at a high level)
statute_40_251_shutdown_extension_mandatory(Tenant) :-
    tenant_is_shutdown_worker_or_household(Tenant),
    \+ nrs_118a315_exception_applies(Tenant).

/* Core unlawful detainer rule for 40.251(1)(b)(2) */
statute_40_251_unlawful_detainer(Landlord, Tenant, obligations_118a) :-
    dwelling_unit_subject_to_118a(Tenant),
    failed_basic_or_contractual_obligations_under_118a(Tenant),
    statute_40_251_notice_days_required(obligations_118a, RequiredDays),
    notice_served_days(Landlord, Tenant, obligations_118a, ServedDays),
    ServedDays >= RequiredDays,
    notice_expired(Landlord, Tenant, obligations_118a),
    tenant_continues_in_possession(Tenant),
    \+ landlord_consents_to_possession(Landlord, Tenant).

/* ---- NV Rev Stat  40.2512 (2021) ----
   Unlawful detainer for nonpayment after alternative notice and waiting period,
   with shutdown-worker exception.
   (Encoded generally; not used by this scenario.)
*/
statute_40_2512_wait_days(commercial_premises, 5).
statute_40_2512_wait_days(real_property_other_than_commercial, 7).  % judicial days
statute_40_2512_wait_days(mobile_home_lot, 10).

statute_40_2512_unlawful_detainer(_Landlord, Tenant, nonpayment_of_rent) :-
    % Placeholder structure; requires scenario facts that are not asserted here.
    \+ nrs_118a315_exception_applies(Tenant),
    \+ tenant_is_shutdown_worker_or_household(Tenant),
    fail.

/* ---- NV Rev Stat  40.2514 (2021) ----
   Unlawful detainer for certain misconduct after 3-day notice to surrender.
   (Encoded generally; not used by this scenario.)
*/
statute_40_2514_notice_days_required(misconduct_40_2514, 3).

statute_40_2514_unlawful_detainer(_Landlord, _Tenant, misconduct_40_2514) :-
    fail.

/* =========================
   Derived legal conclusions
   ========================= */

% A tenant is in "unlawful detainer" if any encoded statute declares it.
unlawful_detainer(Landlord, Tenant, Ground) :-
    statute_40_251_unlawful_detainer(Landlord, Tenant, Ground).

unlawful_detainer(Landlord, Tenant, Ground) :-
    statute_40_2512_unlawful_detainer(Landlord, Tenant, Ground).

unlawful_detainer(Landlord, Tenant, Ground) :-
    statute_40_2514_unlawful_detainer(Landlord, Tenant, Ground).

% If unlawful detainer is established, landlord can pursue eviction (simplified).
landlord_can_evict_for_ground(Landlord, Tenant, Ground) :-
    unlawful_detainer(Landlord, Tenant, Ground).

/* =========================
   Answer
   ========================= */

housing_answer(Result) :-
    (   scenario_statement,
        landlord_can_evict_for_ground(l1, t1, _Ground)
    ->  Result = yes
    ;   Result = no
    ),
    !.

/* =========================
   Main
   ========================= */

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Can a landlord evict a tenant for violating statutory tenant obligations?
